template.constraints: Match real employee chat: choose New car purchase, Start new Application, then step through mobile, price, EMI, dealer, car details, PDF uploads, and confirm. Use testdata values — do not invent dealer codes.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: Car purchase - new car full flow
variants.goal: Complete new car purchase application end-to-end (mobile, price, dealer, uploads, submit)

phases.description: Say you want new car purchase (e.g. 'i want to purchase a car' then choose new car)
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has started new car application and asked for 10-digit mobile number or Start new Application is visible

phases.description: Provide valid mobile, on-road price, and EMI option
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has accepted mobile and price and asked for dealer name or next car detail

phases.description: Provide dealer name, address, cheque name, manufacturer, model, and fuel type
phases.completionCriteria: Bot has asked to upload undertaking letter or proforma invoice PDF
Bot has accepted undertaking and asked for proforma invoice upload

phases.description: Upload proforma invoice PDF, review preview, and confirm/submit
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms the car purchase request was submitted successfully

variants.name: Car purchase edge - invalid 12-digit mobile rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects 12-digit mobile then accepts valid 10-digit number

phases.description: Navigate to new car Start new Application until mobile prompt
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks for valid 10-digit mobile number
Bot rejects the mobile as invalid and asks for a valid 10-digit number

phases.description: When the bot asks for on-road price, type testdata.onRoadPrice; reply to EMI/dealer prompts with matching testdata if shown next.
phases.completionCriteria: User has typed the on-road price from testdata and the bot has accepted it or has moved on to EMI, dealer, or a later vehicle detail prompt

variants.name: Car purchase edge - invalid 11-digit mobile rejected
variants.goal: Verify bot rejects 11-digit mobile (e.g. 98765432101) before accepting valid number

phases.description: Reach new car mobile number step

phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts mobile and proceeds (e.g. asks on-road price)

variants.name: Car purchase - status check
variants.goal: Check status of a car purchase application

phases.description: Ask for car purchase application status or choose Check Status
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows application status or says no application found

variants.name: Car purchase edge - used old car

phases.description: Request car purchase and select Old car purchase
phases.completionCriteria: Bot acknowledges used/old car flow or explains restrictions
